summary: Implemented court/pbo.py with PboResult and pbo_cscv per Bailey et al. (2017) Alg. 2.3 / pbo-cscv.md §3: contiguous S blocks, itertools.combinations IS halves, midranks, smallest-index IS-best, λ=ln(ω̄/(1-ω̄)), φ = #{λ<0}/C(S,S/2). tests/test_pbo.py covers the §5 S=4 mean-metric fixture (positional logits, phi=0.5) plus fail-closed guards (ndim, non-finite values, N<2, odd/S<2, T%S≠0, non-finite metric). TDD: tests written first (red ImportError), then implementation to green.
